title: Lightly Smoky Italian Vegetable Paccheri
description: A Whole30-friendly Italian dish featuring smoky oil and juicy vegetables, with a bitter twist, shaped into paccheri form and ideal for meal prep.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the diced eggplant, zucchini, and red bell pepper with smoky olive oil, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast the vegetables in the oven for 25 minutes, or until tender.
While the vegetables are roasting, cook the paccheri pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the smoky olive oil over medium heat and add the minced garlic.
Add the chopped kale to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 3-4 minutes.
Combine the cooked paccheri pasta, roasted vegetables, and wilted kale in a large bowl.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the top of the pasta mixture and toss to combine.
Using your hands, shape the pasta mixture into paccheri forms, similar to nigiri.
Serve the Lightly Smoky Italian Vegetable Paccheri hot, garnished with additional kale if desired.
